Application Requirements (By Program)
All applicants must provide official or unofficial transcripts from the institution where they completed their bachelor's degree and any institution(s) attended afterwards.
Unless otherwise stated, GRE refers to the General GRE exam.
Unless otherwise specified by the program, the “essay” is a brief goals statement explaining why your academic and professional experiences motivate you to pursue the degree and how your aims and values align with the program. Applicants applying for research-oriented programs should address how their research interests match with department faculty.
Only program directors can waive an application requirement.
Please reach out directly to the program's director if you think you are eligible for any requirement to be waived.

Transcripts | Essay | 3 References | Resume | Writing Sample
Essay: 1 page single spaced essay addressing the following quetions: What are your professional goals? Why do you wish to obtain a PhD?
References: Provide three (3) letters of recommendation. At least one letter must come from a professor or an individual who describes the applicant's academic performance and writing ability. Letters from senior-level leaders that endorse the applicant's leadership potential are encouraged
Each reference will complete an online Recommendation for Gradaute Admissions form as part of the online application process. Once the applicant enters the name and contact information of recommenders, the recommenders will be emailed a link to create an account to provide a recommendation. Once they log in they will (1) provide contact information; (2) upload a letter of recommendation; and (3) rate the candidate on academic performance, intellectual ability, expressive ability, motivation for study in proposed field and originality
Writing Sample: Provide an original 2-page single-spaced academic writing sample. Pick one current issue facing higher education of interest to you. What is the issue? Why is it important to the field of higher education research and practice?

Essay: 1 page single spaced essay addressing the following questions: What are your professional interests and goals? Why are you interested in higher education? Why do you wish to obtain a MSEd?
References: Provide two (2) letters of recommendation: one academic, one professional. The academic reference must come from a professor or an individual who describes the applicant's academic performance and writing ability. The professional reference may be any individual who describes the applicant's leadership potential and work ethic.
Each reference will complete an online Recommendation for Graduate Admissions form as part of the online application process. Once the applicant enters the names and contact information of recommenders, the recommenders will be emailed a link to create an account to provide a recommendation.
